description: This file contains unit tests for core data elements, linked data elements, and data parsers, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests methods related to DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser classes, including copying, CRC, size management, and search functionalities.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with buffer management, copy, CRC, and search functionalities.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked data element with methods for buffer management and linkage.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parses data elements with methods for validation, size retrieval, and skipping bytes.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from source to destination.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the size of the data element.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum for the data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the data element is valid.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number in the data element.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specific position in the data element.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the data element.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in parsing.
